title: US lithium-ion BESS room ruleset (IFC 2024 / NFPA 855-2023)
changelog: 1.0.0 — Initial encoding of the 2026-10-21 fire protection and fire alarm lead inputs.

scope.summary: US lithium-ion BESS rooms only. Sprinklers are wet, dry, or double-interlock preaction.

li_ion_threshold_kwh.summary: Lithium-ion energy at or above this value per room brings the ESS room rules into effect.

max_kwh_fire_area.summary: Aggregate lithium-ion energy allowed in one fire area. The FP lead marked this table value unconfirmed.

fire_area_warn_band.summary: Warn when a fire area is within this fraction of the energy cap, including a value sitting on the cap.

min_room_hr.summary: Minimum fire-resistance of an in-scope BESS room enclosure.

separate_barrier_hr.summary: Barrier rating treated as required to make a separate fire area. F-1 occupancy is assumed and editable.

separate_horizontal_hr.summary: Floor and ceiling rating treated as required before two rooms count as separate fire areas.

sprinkler_density_gpm_sf.summary: Baseline sprinkler density. A lower density is accepted only when a UL 9540A report is on file.

sprinkler_area_cap_sf.summary: Design area is the room area but not more than this cap, before any dry or preaction increase.

dry_di_area_factor.summary: Dry and double-interlock preaction design area increase. The FP lead marked the subsection unconfirmed.

hose_allowance_gpm.summary: Default hose allowance. Assumed and editable on the project.

hose_duration_min.summary: Default hose duration used for the worksheet water volume. Assumed and editable.

hazen_williams_c.summary: Hazen-Williams C recorded for the design basis. This workbook does not run a pipe model.

duct_min_psi.summary: Minimum pressure used for the duct sprinkler flow worksheet.

sprinkler_block_kwh.summary: Sprinkler sign-off is blocked when a group above this size has no UL 9540A report on file.

alarm_lfl_pct_max.summary: Exhaust start and low alarm at or below this fraction of the vent-gas LFL. Subsection is to be verified.

design_lfl_pct_limit.summary: Design concentration of the vent-gas mixture. FP lead says 25 percent; FA lead says below 25 percent.

h2_max_inches_from_ceiling.summary: Default hydrogen sensor location is within this distance of the ceiling. Not a fixed code height.

facp_standby_hours.summary: FACP standby duration used by the battery worksheet.

facp_alarm_minutes.summary: FACP alarm duration when the system is not a voice system.

facp_voice_alarm_minutes.summary: FACP alarm duration when voice evacuation is indicated.

gas_standby_hours.summary: Gas panel standby duration. FA lead says verify this against NFPA 855 and IFC 1207.6.1.2.

gas_alarm_hours.summary: Gas panel alarm duration for sensors and horns. Subsection is to be verified.

battery_margin_fraction.summary: Minimum spare capacity applied on top of the calculated ampere-hours.

default_aging_derate.summary: Default aging multiplier. The lead requires a derate and leaves the factor to the engineer.

default_temp_derate.summary: Default temperature multiplier. The lead requires a derate and leaves the factor to the engineer.

exhaust_standby_hours.summary: Standby power duration checked for the gas exhaust fan. Subsection is to be verified.

molar_volume_ft3.citation: Ideal-gas helper at 70 F and 1 atm
molar_volume_ft3.summary: Molar volume used by the release-mass helper. It is not a code value.

standard_battery_ah.summary: Standard battery sizes. The worksheet selects the next size at or above the required ampere-hours.

default_gases.summary: Gas list used until a UL 9540A report names the species.

gas_properties.citation: Physical-property defaults; confirm against the SDS and UL 9540A
gas_properties.summary: Molecular weight and LFL defaults for the release helper when the user does not type them.

rules.title: United States only
rules.summary: This workbench blocks a project that is not in the United States.
rules.lead_note: US only. Non-US code bases are out of scope.

rules.title: Recorded code editions
rules.summary: Warn when a project edition or ruleset version drifts from the rules file the engine is using.
rules.lead_note: Defaults are IFC/IBC/IMC 2024, NEC 2023, NFPA 855-2023, 72-2022, 13-2025, and 69-2024.

rules.title: Lithium-ion room threshold
rules.summary: A room at or above the lithium-ion threshold is in scope for the ESS room rules.
rules.lead_note: 20 kWh per room.

rules.title: Energy per fire area
rules.summary: Lithium-ion energy above the fire-area cap fails, and energy within five percent of the cap warns.
rules.lead_note: T1207.5 marked unconfirmed by the FP lead.

rules.title: Two-hour rooms combine; three-hour barriers separate
rules.summary: Rooms in a two-hour enclosure are one fire area. A separate fire area needs a three-hour barrier and a three-hour floor and ceiling.
rules.lead_note: F-1 is assumed for the fire-area separation table and is editable. Horizontal separation cites IBC 711.2.4.2.

rules.title: Two-hour room enclosure
rules.summary: An in-scope BESS room enclosure is at least two hours.

rules.title: UL 9540 listing
rules.summary: In-scope ESS groups are recorded as listed to UL 9540. Confirm the listing section in the adopted IFC.
rules.lead_note: Confirm the section number in the adopted edition before issuing.

rules.title: Array spacing record
rules.summary: Spacing is stored on the group. This ruleset does not apply a numeric spacing limit.
rules.lead_note: The leads did not give a spacing number. Do not invent one in the rules file.

rules.title: Chemistry outside the lithium-ion row
rules.summary: A chemistry other than lithium-ion is flagged so a PE can pick the right threshold row.
rules.lead_note: Only the lithium-ion row is encoded.

rules.title: Smoke detection in each BESS room
rules.summary: Each in-scope BESS room is recorded as having smoke detection.
rules.lead_note: FA item 9. FA items are assumed unless a PE confirms them.

rules.title: Sprinkler system type
rules.summary: Only wet, dry, and double-interlock preaction systems are in scope.
rules.lead_note: Clean agent, foam, water mist, and single-interlock are not available.

rules.title: Density times design area
rules.summary: Sprinkler demand is density times the lesser of the room area and the area cap. Density below the baseline needs a UL 9540A report.

rules.title: Dry and double-interlock area increase
rules.summary: Dry and double-interlock preaction design areas increase by the ruleset factor, and the added area is shown.
rules.lead_note: Subsection marked unconfirmed by the FP lead.

rules.title: Sprinkler sign-off blocked without UL 9540A
rules.summary: Sign-off is blocked when a group above the cutoff has no UL 9540A report. The density math is still shown.
rules.lead_note: FP lead: do not lower density without a 9540A report. The 50 kWh cutoff is a workbench gate.

rules.title: Hazen-Williams C
rules.summary: C is fixed at the ruleset value and is recorded only. There is no pipe-friction model.
rules.lead_note: C=100 fixed.

rules.title: Hose allowance
rules.summary: Hose flow and duration are project inputs that start from the assumed lead defaults.
rules.lead_note: 100 gpm and 60 min, editable.

rules.title: Duct sprinkler flow
rules.summary: Duct sprinkler flow is K times the square root of pressure, and pressure under the minimum fails.
rules.lead_note: q = K * sqrt(p), 7 psi minimum.

rules.title: UL 9540A report missing
rules.summary: A missing UL 9540A report is an automatic open item for every group that has energy.
rules.lead_note: Auto RFI.

rules.title: No fire or smoke damper on gas exhaust
rules.summary: The gas exhaust duct does not get a fire damper or a smoke damper.

rules.title: No balancing damper on gas exhaust
rules.summary: The gas exhaust duct does not get a balancing damper.

rules.title: No backdraft damper on gas exhaust
rules.summary: Avoid a backdraft damper on the gas exhaust.
rules.lead_note: FP lead: avoid backdraft dampers.

rules.title: Rated shaft for the gas exhaust
rules.summary: A duct that crosses a rated assembly uses a rated shaft, unless it terminates directly at an exterior wall or roof.

rules.title: Motorized damper fail-open and proven open
rules.summary: A motorized exhaust damper fails open and proves open to the FACP.
rules.lead_note: Fail-open plus proven-open to the FACP.

rules.title: Dampers in other ducts through BESS walls
rules.summary: Other ducts through a BESS wall use a three-hour damper in a three-hour wall and a 1.5-hour damper in a wall under three hours.

rules.title: Gas exhaust duct constraints
rules.summary: FA lead item 10 is the same gas-exhaust duct constraint set evaluated by the IMC line items.
rules.lead_note: FA item 10. No fire, smoke, backdraft, or balancing damper, and a rated shaft where the duct crosses a rated assembly.

rules.title: Low alarm starts exhaust and makeup
rules.summary: A low alarm from either gas starts exhaust and makeup air, latched, with manual reset.
rules.lead_note: H2 or DMC. Latched. Manual reset.

rules.title: Fire alarm does not stop gas exhaust
rules.summary: An HVAC shutdown sequence that includes the gas exhaust fails.
rules.lead_note: FA item 8.

rules.title: Exhaust fan standby power
rules.summary: The gas exhaust fan is on standby power for the ruleset duration. Verify the subsection before relying on it.
rules.lead_note: FA item 12. VERIFY NFPA 855 and IFC 1207.6.1.2.

rules.title: Low-alarm setpoint
rules.summary: The low alarm and exhaust start are at or below 10 percent of the vent-gas LFL. The subsection needs PE review.
rules.lead_note: FA item 2 is marked NEEDS PE REVIEW and the subsection is to be verified. FP lead states alarm at 10 percent LFL.

rules.title: Design LFL fraction
rules.summary: A design fraction above 25 percent fails. Exactly 25 percent warns because the FA lead requires a value below 25 percent.
rules.lead_note: FP lead says design at 25 percent and marked 9.6.5.6 unconfirmed. FA lead says design below 25 percent.

rules.title: Release mass-balance helper
rules.summary: Ideal-gas release helper from user-entered UL 9540A masses. It does not replace a PE dispersion analysis.
rules.citation: Ideal-gas helper at 70 F and 1 atm
rules.lead_note: Helper only. Mixture LFL uses Le Chatelier on the combustible fraction.

rules.title: Setpoint conversion
rules.summary: Converting a release case or a single-gas percent LEL into a mixture percent LFL needs PE review.
rules.lead_note: FA header: setpoint conversion NEEDS PE REVIEW.

rules.title: One sensor per listed gas per room
rules.summary: Each room has at least one sensor for every gas on the detection list.
rules.lead_note: FA item 1. The default list is hydrogen and DMC until UL 9540A names the gases.

rules.title: Single-gas percent LEL
rules.summary: A single-gas percent LEL setpoint without UL 9540A mixture data is an open item.
rules.lead_note: FA item 2 flags vendor single-gas percent LEL setpoints. FP lead: single-gas percent LEL is not enough without 9540A gas data.

rules.title: Monitoring-only or BACnet-only gas detection
rules.summary: Gas detection that is monitoring-only or BACnet-only fails hard when it is the explosion control. Life safety is hardwired.
rules.lead_note: FA item 4.

rules.title: Gas horns are not on fire-alarm NACs
rules.summary: Gas horns on fire-alarm notification appliance circuits fail hard.
rules.lead_note: FA item 5.

rules.title: Gas notification distinct from fire alarm
rules.summary: Gas notification is distinct from the fire alarm.
rules.lead_note: FA item 5.

rules.title: Relay map R1, R2, R3, and fault
rules.summary: Low alarm drives exhaust and makeup on R1 and a gas alarm to the FACP on R2. High alarm drives horns on R3. The fault relay is trouble to the FACP.
rules.lead_note: FA item 3.

rules.title: Hydrogen sensor near the ceiling
rules.summary: Hydrogen sensors are high and within 12 inches of the ceiling unless a PE accepts another spot.
rules.lead_note: FA item 6. No fixed height rule; this is the default location.

rules.title: DMC sensor low
rules.summary: DMC sensors are mounted low. There is no fixed dimension in the lead rules.
rules.lead_note: FA item 6.

rules.title: Sensor height still an open item
rules.summary: Each sensor height stays open until the vendor justifies it from UL 9540A data and airflow with exhaust on and exhaust failed.
rules.lead_note: FA item 6.

rules.title: Proof points and input shortfall
rules.summary: Fan, makeup, and damper-open proofs are supervisory. Points that do not fit on the gas panel move to FACP monitor modules.
rules.lead_note: FA item 7. Loss of proof is supervisory.

rules.title: Signals to the supervising station
rules.summary: Gas alarm, trouble, and supervisory signals are indicated to the supervising station.
rules.lead_note: FA item 9. Confirm the transmission section in the adopted NFPA 72.

rules.title: Relay landings not shown
rules.summary: Missing relay landings on the controls drawings are an automatic open item.
rules.lead_note: Auto RFI.

rules.title: High-gas signal to the FACP
rules.summary: No high-gas signal to the FACP is an automatic open item.
rules.lead_note: Auto RFI. Local horns on R3 are not a substitute for the FACP signal.

rules.title: Cause and effect does not stop exhaust
rules.summary: Any matrix mark that stops the gas exhaust fails.
rules.lead_note: FA item 8, applied to the matrix.

rules.title: Cause and effect source
rules.summary: The matrix is generated from the lead sequence until someone edits it. An edit that drifts from the room list warns.

rules.title: FACP battery duration
rules.summary: FACP battery worksheet uses 24 hours of standby plus 5 minutes of alarm, or 15 minutes when voice is indicated.
rules.lead_note: FA item 11.

rules.title: Gas panel battery duration
rules.summary: Gas panel, sensors, and horns use 24 hours of standby plus 2 hours of alarm. Verify the subsection.
rules.lead_note: FA item 12. VERIFY NFPA 855 and IFC 1207.6.1.2.

rules.title: Battery margin and derate
rules.summary: The worksheet applies at least 20 percent spare capacity plus aging and temperature derates, then picks the next standard size.
rules.lead_note: FA item 13. Derate factors are engineer inputs and default above 1.

rules.title: Door hardware follows the barrier
rules.summary: Two-hour versus three-hour barriers drive door hardware, and hold-open devices release on fire alarm. This stays an open coordination item until it is closed.
rules.lead_note: FA item 14.
